key_highlights: Global bond yields hit highest since 2008, with Japan's 10-year at 3% (first since 1996), triggering broad risk-off sentiment
Oil tops $90 amid US-Iran Strait of Hormuz clashes; depleted US reserves amplify energy shock
Warsh's Jackson Hole speech revives Fed rate-hike bets, pressuring equities, crypto, and gold simultaneously
Mortgage rates surge to highest since June 2025; CD rates up to 4.30% APY signal tightening cycle
Goldman's Kaplan signals hawkish tilt; Bessent pressures BOJ for further hikes, creating Fed-Treasury tension
China's official activity gauges hint at economic turnaround, offering potential global growth support
Energy sector outperforms: PetroChina H1 profit +22% record; Frontline best quarter; Chevron underperforming peers
Consumer stress visible: firearms retailer Chapter 11, kids clothing giant closing 29 stores, Affirm cautious despite blowout quarter
AI capex concerns: Uber burned entire 2026 AI budget in 4 months; SoftBank $5.5B OpenAI data-center deal signals massive AI infrastructure spend
Boeing engineers authorize October strike despite accelerated 737 production, creating supply-chain risk

key_themes: Bond yield spike as dominant macro driver across all asset classes
US-Iran conflict as primary geopolitical risk with energy transmission
Fed policy pivot risk: Warsh hawkish signal vs. Treasury pressure creates institutional tension
AI infrastructure capex supercycle with efficiency questions
Consumer credit stress and retail consolidation
Japan's yield normalization as structural shift in global capital flows
Crypto under rate-hike pressure but MicroStrategy signals potential accumulation
Energy transition tension: oil shock vs. electricity's rising political relevance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran Escalation / Strait of Hormuz Disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy (XOM, CVX, FRO); hold 10-15% energy allocation; monitor Hormuz shipping; maintain oil hedges via USO or futures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Bond Yield Spike / Rate Hike Cycle
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favor TIPS and short-duration bonds; lock in CD rates at 4.30%; avoid long-duration equities; monitor 10Y yield as 3%+ threshold
Watch for policy incoherence signals; favor financials (BAC) that benefit from higher rates; avoid rate-sensitive growth

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Boeing October Strike / Supply Chain Disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BA exposure; monitor aerospace supply chain; consider competitors (Airbus) as relative value
Underweight consumer discretionary; favor staples (PEP); monitor Affirm (AFRM) delinquency trends; avoid high-beta retail
Favor AI infrastructure (data centers, chips) over application layer; monitor Uber-style budget overruns as warning signal
Limit crypto allocation to <5%; watch BTC $80K as resistance; MicroStrategy (MSTR) accumulation as contrarian signal

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy sector and oil-linked equities
opportunities.rationale: Oil above $90 with depleted US reserves and active Iran conflict creates sustained supply premium; record profits at PetroChina and Frontline confirm earnings power

opportunities.recommendation: Lock in high-yield cash equivalents (CDs at 4.30%, savings at 4.15%)
opportunities.rationale: Rate-hike cycle supports higher yields; 19-bp HELOC differential suggests further tightening; cash yields now competitive with equity risk-adjusted returns
Official activity gauges signal inflection; potential global growth support if China stabilizes; under-owned relative to Western markets

opportunities.recommendation: Selective AI infrastructure plays over application layer
opportunities.rationale: $5.5B SoftBank-OpenAI deal and Uber's budget exhaustion signal infrastructure demand persists while application efficiency is questioned
AbbVie and Merck outperforming in risk-off; BRAF research pipeline supports long-term pharma value; sector benefits from rate uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration; favor TIPS and 1-3 year treasuries
defensive_moves.rationale: Yields at 2008 highs with further hike risk; Japan 3% 10Y signals global repricing; long-duration faces capital loss risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and high-beta retail exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bankruptcies, store closures, and cautious consumer signals (Affirm CEO) indicate credit stress; energy costs compress disposable income

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity with short-volatility or put spreads on S&P 500
defensive_moves.rationale: Risk-off sentiment from bond selloff, oil spike, and geopolitical conflict; August was 'winning but turbulent' suggesting fragility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Boeing and aerospace supply chain names pre-strike
defensive_moves.rationale: October engineer strike authorized despite production ramp; potential 2-4 week production halt creates earnings and delivery risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 5-10% gold allocation as geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Gold dipped on rate-hike fears but Iran conflict and yield volatility support long-term safe-haven demand; Warsh speech may create buying opportunity

market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off dominates: bond yields at 2008 highs, oil above $90, and Fed hike bets create headwinds for equities and crypto. Expect 3-5% equity volatility. Energy and TIPS outperform. Consumer and rate-sensitive sectors under pressure. Boeing strike adds idiosyncratic risk. Watch for Fed-Treasury policy conflict to amplify uncertainty.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict de-escalates and China turnaround materializes, 6-12 month outlook improves. AI infrastructure capex cycle supports tech earnings. Higher-for-longer rates favor financials and energy. Consumer recovery depends on energy price normalization. Japan's yield normalization reshapes global capital flows. Structural shifts in energy (electricity vs. oil) and AI efficiency will define winners.
